%lld s.note: Running time in a stat tile, seconds, short unit.

%lld min.line: if s < 3600 { return String(localized: "\(s / 60) min", bundle: .main) }

%lld h %@ min.note: Running time, e.g. '1 h 05 min'. %@ is two-digit minutes. Use your language's usual short units.

TLS records at %@.line: case "--tlsrec": return String(localized: "TLS records at \(value)", bundle: .main)
TLS records at %@.note: Summary line; %@ is a technical position like 'sniext+1'.

Split at %@.note: Summary line; %@ is a technical position like '1,midsld'.

OOB.note: Short label inside a generated strategy name, e.g. 'Split at 1 · OOB' (out-of-band byte). Keep it very short; OOB may stay as is.

Disorder.note: tpws option name in a summary line ('Split at 1,midsld · Disorder').

Host case.note: Short label inside a generated strategy name: the Host header written as 'host'.

Host spelled %@.note: Short label inside a generated strategy name; %@ is the spelling, e.g. hoSt.

Dot after host.line: case "--hostdot": return String(localized: "Dot after host", bundle: .main)

Tab after host.line: case "--hosttab": return String(localized: "Tab after host", bundle: .main)

No space after Host:.line: case "--hostnospace": return String(localized: "No space after Host:", bundle: .main)

MiXeD domain case.line: case "--domcase": return String(localized: "MiXeD domain case", bundle: .main)
MiXeD domain case.note: Toggle: write the domain in mixed upper/lower case. Show the mixed case playfully in your own word if natural.

Host padding %@.note: Short label inside a generated strategy name; %@ is a byte count, e.g. 1024.

Extra space after method.line: case "--methodspace": return String(localized: "Extra space after method", bundle: .main)
Extra space after method.note: Toggle: add a space after the HTTP method (GET/POST).

Unix line endings.line: case "--unixeol": return String(localized: "Unix line endings", bundle: .main)

Line break before method.line: case "--methodeol": return String(localized: "Line break before method", bundle: .main)
Line break before method.note: Toggle: add a line break before the HTTP method (GET/POST).

OOB byte.note: tpws option in a summary line: an out-of-band (urgent) TCP byte.

%lld HTTP tricks.line: if http > 0 { parts.append(String(localized: "\(http) HTTP tricks", bundle: .main)) }
